title: HolmesGPT MCP — Usage
description: Usage of the HolmesGPT MCP server from Claude Code, read from Langfuse's ClickHouse.

panels.title: Investigations
panels.description: New HolmesGPT investigations (ask_holmes calls) in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
calls AS (
    SELECT
        t.id AS trace_id,
        t.timestamp AS ts,
        t.name AS kind,
        ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') AS user,
        ifNull(t.session_id, '') AS session_id,
        trim(BOTH '"' FROM t.metadata['hostname']) AS host
    FROM default.traces AS t FINAL
    WHERE t.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND has(t.tags, 'holmes-mcp')
      AND t.is_deleted = 0
      AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
      AND ('__all' IN (${user:singlequote}) OR ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') IN (${user:singlequote}))
)
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(kind = 'ask_holmes') AS Investigations
FROM calls GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Share of calls where HolmesGPT returned a complete answer (not an error, cut off or cancelled).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
calls AS (
    SELECT
        t.id AS trace_id,
        t.timestamp AS ts,
        t.name AS kind,
        ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') AS user,
        ifNull(t.session_id, '') AS session_id,
        trim(BOTH '"' FROM t.metadata['hostname']) AS host
    FROM default.traces AS t FINAL
    WHERE t.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND has(t.tags, 'holmes-mcp')
      AND t.is_deleted = 0
      AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
      AND ('__all' IN (${user:singlequote}) OR ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') IN (${user:singlequote}))
),
roots AS (
    SELECT
        o.trace_id,
        o.level,
        ifNull(o.status_message, '') AS status_message,
        if(o.end_time IS NULL, NULL, dateDiff('millisecond', o.start_time, o.end_time) / 1000) AS duration_s,
        JSONExtractString(ifNull(o.input, ''), 'question') AS question
    FROM default.observations AS o FINAL
    WHERE o.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND upper(o.type) = 'AGENT'
      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.start_time >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND o.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calls)
)
SELECT countIf(r.level NOT IN ('ERROR', 'WARNING', '')) / nullIf(countIf(r.level != ''), 0) AS "Success rate"
FROM calls AS c LEFT JOIN roots AS r ON r.trace_id = c.trace_id

panels.title: Outcomes
panels.description: How calls ended. Success = complete answer; Cut off = HolmesGPT hit a time limit or stopped early; Cancelled = the user or Claude Code stopped the call; Error = HolmesGPT failed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
calls AS (
    SELECT
        t.id AS trace_id,
        t.timestamp AS ts,
        t.name AS kind,
        ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') AS user,
        ifNull(t.session_id, '') AS session_id,
        trim(BOTH '"' FROM t.metadata['hostname']) AS host
    FROM default.traces AS t FINAL
    WHERE t.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND has(t.tags, 'holmes-mcp')
      AND t.is_deleted = 0
      AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
      AND ('__all' IN (${user:singlequote}) OR ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') IN (${user:singlequote}))
),
roots AS (
    SELECT
        o.trace_id,
        o.level,
        ifNull(o.status_message, '') AS status_message,
        if(o.end_time IS NULL, NULL, dateDiff('millisecond', o.start_time, o.end_time) / 1000) AS duration_s,
        JSONExtractString(ifNull(o.input, ''), 'question') AS question
    FROM default.observations AS o FINAL
    WHERE o.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND upper(o.type) = 'AGENT'
      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.start_time >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND o.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calls)
)
SELECT multiIf(
        r.level = 'ERROR', 'Error',
        r.level = 'WARNING' AND r.status_message LIKE 'cancelled%', 'Cancelled',
        r.level = 'WARNING', 'Cut off',
        r.level = '', 'Unknown',
        'Success') AS Outcome, count() AS Calls
FROM calls AS c LEFT JOIN roots AS r ON r.trace_id = c.trace_id
GROUP BY Outcome ORDER BY Calls DESC

panels.title: Who used it, when
panels.description: Every question and follow-up, newest first. Session opens the whole conversation in Langfuse; Trace opens that single call with HolmesGPT's tool calls.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
calls AS (
    SELECT
        t.id AS trace_id,
        t.timestamp AS ts,
        t.name AS kind,
        ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') AS user,
        ifNull(t.session_id, '') AS session_id,
        trim(BOTH '"' FROM t.metadata['hostname']) AS host
    FROM default.traces AS t FINAL
    WHERE t.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND has(t.tags, 'holmes-mcp')
      AND t.is_deleted = 0
      AND $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
      AND ('__all' IN (${user:singlequote}) OR ifNull(t.user_id, 'unknown') IN (${user:singlequote}))
),
roots AS (
    SELECT
        o.trace_id,
        o.level,
        ifNull(o.status_message, '') AS status_message,
        if(o.end_time IS NULL, NULL, dateDiff('millisecond', o.start_time, o.end_time) / 1000) AS duration_s,
        JSONExtractString(ifNull(o.input, ''), 'question') AS question
    FROM default.observations AS o FINAL
    WHERE o.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND upper(o.type) = 'AGENT'
      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.start_time >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND o.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calls)
),
tools AS (
    SELECT o.trace_id, o.name AS tool, o.level
    FROM default.observations AS o FINAL
    WHERE o.project_id = '${project_id}'
      AND upper(o.type) = 'TOOL'
      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.start_time >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND o.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calls)
)
SELECT
    c.ts AS Time,
    c.user AS User,
    c.host AS Host,
    if(c.kind = 'ask_holmes', 'Investigation', 'Follow-up') AS Type,
    if(lengthUTF8(r.question) > 110, concat(leftUTF8(r.question, 110), '…'), r.question) AS Question,
    multiIf(
        r.level = 'ERROR', 'Error',
        r.level = 'WARNING' AND r.status_message LIKE 'cancelled%', 'Cancelled',
        r.level = 'WARNING', 'Cut off',
        r.level = '', 'Unknown',
        'Success') AS Outcome,
    r.duration_s AS "Answer time",
    ifNull(tc.tool_calls, 0) AS Tools,
    c.session_id AS Session,
    'Open trace ↗' AS Trace,
    c.trace_id AS trace_id
FROM calls AS c
LEFT JOIN roots AS r ON r.trace_id = c.trace_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT trace_id, count() AS tool_calls FROM tools GROUP BY trace_id) AS tc
       ON tc.trace_id = c.trace_id
ORDER BY Time DESC
LIMIT 500

      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.start_time >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND o.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calls)
)
SELECT
    c.user AS User,
    arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(c.host, c.host != ''), ', ') AS Hosts,
    countIf(c.kind = 'ask_holmes') AS Investigations,
    countIf(c.kind = 'holmes_follow_up') AS "Follow-ups",
    countIf(r.level NOT IN ('ERROR', 'WARNING', '')) / nullIf(countIf(r.level != ''), 0) AS "Success rate",
    min(c.ts) AS "First seen",
    max(c.ts) AS "Last seen",
    argMax(c.session_id, c.ts) AS "Latest conversation"
FROM calls AS c LEFT JOIN roots AS r ON r.trace_id = c.trace_id
GROUP BY User
ORDER BY "Last seen" DESC
